    # Y not needed here but include for generality

from collections import Counter
cands=['board','carry','chart','guard','major','march','mayor','moral','party','roman','royal','rural']
# score candidates by letter frequency among candidates, pick actual candidate guess
def score(w):
    s=0
    for i,c in enumerate(w):
        s+=sum(1 for x in cands if x[i]==c)
        s+=sum(1 for x in cands if c in x and x[i]!=c)
    return s
for w in sorted(cands,key=score,reverse=True):
    print(w,score(w))
